hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook managing bonding-curve memecoin pools with three fee phases: launch guard (90%–3% decaying anti-sniper fee over ~5s), curve (1% flat until graduation threshold), and graduated (1% flat, pool opens to public LPs). Fees are captured via before/after swap deltas on the quote token and routed to a FeeRouter with an optional referrer extracted from hookData.
